prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Waiting screen enhancements (wait_info) can be helpful, delivering significant wins in three tests (+5.0%, +5.7%, and +4.1%), though two tests showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens (new_screen) can be helpful, winning two tests (+15.4% and +6.4%), though one hurt performance (-7.7%) and one showed no clear effect.
Copy adjustments (copy), layout changes (layout), redesigns (redesign), and hints (hint) showed no clear effect across all tests.
Reordering steps (reorder) showed no clear effect in one test and significantly hurt performance in another (-3.8%).
Predictions underestimated large wins, such as the pet preview screen (+3.0% predicted vs +15.4% measured) and sound selection screen (+4.0% predicted vs +6.4% measured).
Predictions were generally too high for changes that showed no clear effect or resulted in a loss (e.g., predicting +15.4% for the quiz screen which measured -7.7%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +3.9% over 4 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -3.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +0.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +4.2% over 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -3.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +3.5% over 5 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +1.8% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.6% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 24.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Habitat Selection Screen: Insert a dedicated habitat selection screen where users choose their companion's default desktop resting nook before final adoption. (why: Adoption has a long median time (89s). Adding new interactive customization screens in earlier tests delivered major conversion gains (+15.4% and +6.4%).)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Spotlight View: Redesign the home intro screen into a spotlight layout highlighting shortcut badges to summon, hide, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and multiple support emails express post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide the pet.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Audio & Sound Effect Teaser: Add an interactive audio soundboard on the waiting screen allowing users to trigger and preview pet purrs, barks, and chirp SFX. (why: Wait info features consistently drive retention gains (+5.7%, +4.1%) during the long loading window before the pet appears on screen.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Trait Customization Flow: Introduce a behavioral trait selection screen into the adoption sub-flow allowing users to configure personality traits like curious, gentle, or playful. (why: Enhancing companion customization deepens user investment before desktop launch and aligns with proven new screen wins (+15.4%).)
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync & Pet Safety Clarification: Update the sign in copy to clearly explain that signing in backs up the user's pet customization and prevents loss or reset upon sign in. (why: 8 support tickets reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in step drops conversion to 72.9%.)
5: [choose_path, reorder] Move Sign In After Path Selection Flow: Reorder the onboarding sequence so users choose their companion path and customize their pet before encountering the sign-in step. (why: Sign in conversion currently sits at 72.9%. Allowing users to personalize their pet first builds motivation before sign-in.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Customization Quality Guidelines Hint: Add an inline hint to the photo upload screen providing lighting and photo clarity guidelines for accurate custom pet rendering. (why: Support data indicates 3 users experienced custom pet creation failures or visual glitches during photo generation.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Engine Status Progress Notification: Add an active progress bar and notification trigger on the waiting screen updating users as desktop animation engines initialize. (why: Waiting step mean duration is 2336s, and 3 users reported pets failing to show up or open on the desktop.)

scores.note: New screens in customization have high historical wins (+15.4%), but require full release.
Finish step loses 35.2% and has support complaints, but redesigns consistently fail (-3.0%).
Wait info screen additions show reliable historical wins (+3.5% overall avg).
Interactive customization screens perform well, though adding new flow requires build effort.
Config-only change backed by 8 support tickets and high step drop-off (27.1%).
Reordering steps previously hurt performance (-3.8%) and has low confidence.
Config-only hint targeting specific support tickets, but hints generally show no clear effect.
Wait screen improvements have strong confidence and both support/funnel point to long wait times.
